Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: initial sizing signal

Priyom / Redwood team,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. We have steady growth on our chat inference workload and leadership wants predictable unit economics — so moving a portion of our production traffic off the public hosted tier into a Dedicated pool is on the roadmap. Before we start procurement we need a pragmatic sizing plan and a clear cutover timeline we can tuck into our Q2 launch sprint.

High-level constraints:
- Peak concurrent active sessions: ~1,200 (90th percentile)
- Avg request length: 180 tokens; 95th: 480 tokens
- Target 95th latency <= 280ms per token (end-to-end)
- We will keep customer prompt data in our VPC; we need isolation and audit logs

Can you send a suggested initial GPU mix (gpus / shapes), expected RPS headroom for canary, and a proposed 3-week cutover calendar? Also attach any sizing template you prefer.

Appreciate it — Alex

Alex Chen

Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: initial sizing signal

Alex — thanks for the clear signal and constraints. Attaching a lightweight sizing template (astranova-sizing-template.xlsx) that we'll use to model throughput/cost tradeoffs. High level proposal below; see attached for assumptions and per-model perf numbers.

Proposal summary (first-pass):
- Baseline fleet: 6 x A100-80GB equiv (shared pools) + 8 x H100-80GB for peak inference.
- Expected steady-state capacity (with continuous batching + prefix cache): 1,500 concurrent sessions equivalent (comfortable 25% headroom).
- Canary footprint: 2 x H100 + 2 x A100 reserved for the canary group (5% traffic).
- KV/prefix cache: enable 64GB reserved cache nodes to reduce token generation by ~15% for repeat prompts.
- Expected per-token cost delta (hosted -> dedicated): ~35% lower on GPU ops after accounting infra + reserved amortization.

Cutover sprint (proposed 3-week cadence):
Week 0: Prep & data collections
  - Inventory current route maps, pin production model versions
  - Telemetry export: 7 days of 95/99 latencies, seq len histogram (we will help export)
Week 1: Staging run + perf validation
  - Provision full dedicated test pool in our staging region (mirror model, quantization profile)
  - Run synthetic load and subset of live shadow traffic
Week 2: Canary (5% -> 25%)
  - Day 1: 5% traffic; 48h health check + rollback gate
  - Day 3: 15% if healthy; Day 5: 25%
  - Monitor token costs, latencies, error rates; invoke fallbacks if >1.5x error budget
Week 3: Full swap + monitoring ramp
  - Final cutover window (2-4h low-traffic pref) + post-cutover 72h SLO watch

Immediate asks from your side to finalize the plan:
1) Share a 7-day telemetry export (we sent a simple dumper script in the shared Drive link).
2) Confirm regulatory/KMS needs for the VPC (we support Bring-Your-Own-KMS via customer KMS).
3) Procurement lead contact for DocuSign timeline.

I dropped the staging checklist and perf assumptions into this Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AstraNova-Sizing. I'll also open a HubSpot deal record for coordination: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/AN-2028-031.

Attaching: astranova-sizing-template.xlsx (spreadsheet with model profiles, expected RPS/seq length matrix).

Thanks — Priyom
